Note on Block Widths

Block Widths are optional and must be enabled to take effect. Controls are available for Bases, Tables, iFrames, PDF Embeds, Callouts, Images, Video, Audio, Blockquotes, Code Blocks, Lists, and Note Embeds. Additional controls below apply in Live Preview and Reading Mode; Source Mode keeps its normal text layout.

Note on Typography

Global typography settings (like global font sizes, underlines, bold, italic, and strikethrough) are controlled in the Global Typography section. Settings specific to the editor (like Header and Canvas font sizes) can be found within this Editor section.

Note on Block Widths

Block Widths are optional and must be enabled to take effect. Controls are available for Bases, Tables, iFrames, PDF Embeds, Callouts, Images, Video, Audio, Blockquotes, Code Blocks, Lists, and Note Embeds. Additional controls below apply in Live Preview and Reading Mode; Source Mode keeps its normal text layout.
